name: dwarf-fortress-voxel-viewer

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests desktop scripts *.ts *.json *.cjs .github/workflows/*.yml docs/*.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests desktop scripts *.ts *.json *.cjs .github/workflows/*.yml docs/*.md README.md
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never && node scripts/checksums.mjs

description: A live voxel viewer with digging and designation tools for Dwarf Fortress and DFHack
author: Mark Baldwin-Smith
